findings.description: WP21.2 audit_evidence now accepts nonempty native_training_logs/ as a directory artifact. Round01 FAIL/57 is unchanged; the old auditor trailing-slash mismatch is a separate evidence-gate issue.

Two seed=7 native SAELens TopK runs share corpus hash, model revision, steps=16, batch=64, k=8 and seed=7. Plans differ only in run_name. W_dec still diverges: max_abs=0.08271190151572227, failing_elements=147398/147456. Seed is present in TrainPlan and LanguageModelSAERunnerConfig. Current process has deterministic_algorithms_enabled=false and cudnn_deterministic=false. First locatable numerical source is CUDA/SAELens TopK nondeterminism, not missing seed plumbing.
